scope: Initial C1 ground locomotion, aiming, log mining and pickup

review.movement: Live human walk/strafe/jump, collision/step/ledge/fall and complete sprint-state references agree with existing development bounds; exact timing caveats remain.
review.view: Native degree conventions and bounded pitch; human view reference and fake heading/aiming checks.
review.mine_pickup: Human log break 60 ticks vs fake 61-62; interrupted restart 60 vs 61; normal inventory collection follows observed break. Causal UUID scoring belongs to G2.
review.block_reach: Real-player block reach attribute 4.5; compatibility guard calls the native isWithinBlockInteractionRange predicate. Near mining/placement is human-recorded; source/attribute review supplies the guard boundary rather than claiming a measured client reach threshold.
review.death_replacement: Carpet fake death intentionally disconnects. Live suite proves terminal death and fresh registered Survival body. Human respawn is not the lifecycle being imitated.
review.extensions: Entity attacks, combat knockback, construction and dimension travel are outside the initial C1 policy profile. Supplementary development checks remain evidence, not full-game qualification.

handoff_basis: C0 checks pass; human references used where relevant to initial C1. Handoff section 4 permits marking capabilities unqualified; excluded capabilities require later qualification before scored use.
limits: No scored episodes or provider calls
Qualified profile must be enforced by later runners
